title: Childhood after his mother's death, country school and return to town
summary: After his mother died Humphrey lived in the country, attended short school terms, and later returned to the New Orleans house.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: And I wanted you to tell me more about your, the way you grew up. Did you hear much music around the house when you were growing up?
Oh, yeah. Sure. See, after my mother died, went to Aime, Louisiana, and stayed there until, I think about, I was six years old, I think, when my mother died.
My sister was baby. My sister was about four. I must have been sick. Bill must have been about eight. It's, you know, it's about two years apart.

When they Aime of Louisiana and stayed out there and went to school out there, you're in the country there. They give you three months school and when the crop come in, you turn out to school to pick up the crop. Mm-hmm. All like that. Well, after then, I got about 10, 12 years old. My father, he's going to California, I think. Well, my head come up there and got us, got me in prison for us in the island. Stayed right out there. You just, see where you just left out there?
Well, that's where we stayed. Absolutely.
Which long house? Right behind, you see where I hang them clothes at? Mm-hmm. Right there.
